text:
For the broken egg on the floor

for the 5th of July

for the fish in the fishbowl

for the old man in room No. 9

for the cat on the wall.


For yourself

not for fame

or for money

you have to keep fighting.


When you get old

the attraction diminishes

it is easier when one is young

anyone can reach

the heights now and then.


The key consists in

enduring.


Anything that helps

so that

this life keeps dancing

in front of

Lady Death.

translation.title: Creative Act
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the poem's motive for making art as endurance before Lady Death.
